architecture: Dimension -> Feature two-layer; all rows are evidence_only or context_only and no cross-body D03 similarity score is produced.

actual_indexed_queryable_coverage.note: Eight Earth reference points with NASA POWER daily time series; each point is a coarse grid location, not a 1.98 km in-situ measurement. Three expansion AOIs were added 2026-11-15.

sources.version: POWER daily point API; method nasa-power-daily-1.0.0 / thermal context export acquisition-release-1.0.0
sources.licence: NASA POWER data are free and open; cite NASA POWER
sources.access: official public HTTPS API; bounded point/day queries with checkpointed raw JSON in pilot
sources.crs_frame: Earth geographic point (WGS84 longitude/latitude query); native model grid approximately 0.5 x 0.625 degree
sources.resolution: approximately 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid point; not 1.98 km

sources.depth_support: 2 m air temperature and surface skin temperature; not subsurface
sources.qa: finite-value checks; coarse reanalysis/model context, not local measurement

sources.legal_score_filter_roles: context_only only; excluded from cross-body similarity scoring

features.local_solar_time: not_applicable (daily aggregate at model grid; no sub-daily LST)
features.season_support: single 7-day winter (Northern Hemisphere) window in committed pilot; seasonal representativeness not claimed
features.day_night_support: daily mean/max/min parameters available; no instantaneous day/night split
features.footprint: coarse ~0.5x0.625 degree POWER grid point centered on area reference; footprint much larger than 1.98 km window
features.gaps: no sub-daily/local-solar-time, no kinetic surface temperature observation, no thermal inertia, no multi-season committed expansion

features.day_night_support: daily maximum statistic; not an instantaneous observation time

features.gaps: skin temperature is model/reanalysis; not comparable to Diviner brightness temperature or THEMIS TI

expansion_2026_11_15.note: Real bounded NASA POWER daily point ingest for three existing fine candidates; coarse reanalysis context, not local measurement.

sources.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / UCLA Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment
sources.product: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (PCP), average bolometric brightness temperature, south pole summer
sources.version: PDS4 collection/product 1.0; calibration software 4.0; files PCP_AVG_TBOL_POLS_SUM_LTIM01_240.TAB and PCP_AVG_TBOL_POLS_SUM_LTIM49_240.TAB
sources.licence: NASA PDS public archive; no explicit licence field in the PDS4 label; cite Williams et al. (2019) doi:10.1029/2019JE006028

sources.crs_frame: Polar stereographic, planetocentric, positive east, sphere R=1737400 m (+proj=stere +lat_0=-90 +lat_ts=-90 +lon_0=0 +R=1737400); coordinate_frame lunar_projected in typed areas
sources.resolution: 240 m/pixel native bins; 1.98 km circular window spatial mean; not resampled to 90 m

sources.qa: sparse bins omitted; invalid/unknown special constants rejected; no per-bin uncertainty; rejected/row counts recorded
sources.uncertainty: no per-bin uncertainty supplied by product; spatial variability recorded as min/max/std in legacy_provenance

features.measured_modeled_derived_evidence_no_cov: measured_radiometric_composite evidence with explicit states: detected/unknown/no_coverage
features.season_support: southern summer composite only (subsolar latitude < 0 deg)
features.day_night_support: night bin 00:00-00:15 and day bin 12:00-12:15 represented as separate local-time observations; not a same-sol pair and no diurnal range computed
features.footprint: circular 1.98 km window (radius 990 m) of native 240 m bins; bbox recorded in projected lunar frame; native resolution preserved
features.uncertainty: unknown per-bin/product; spatial n/min/max/std and valid_fraction recorded per observation
features.gaps: only 2 of 96 possible local-time bins committed; no_coverage at 7 noon windows and unknown at 3 sparse noon windows (genuine missing/sparse native data, not zero-filled); no kinetic temperature; no diurnal range/change rate; polar cap 80-90S only for this product

actual_indexed_queryable_coverage.area_note: 5 existing Jezero CTX reference windows inside THEMIS quantitative TI tile 00N060E

sources.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / Arizona State University / NASA Mars Data Analysis Program
sources.product: THEMIS-derived global thermal inertia mosaic, quantitative 32-bit, edition 1
sources.licence: Public domain (USGS Astrogeology access constraints); cite Fergason et al. (2006) doi:10.1029/2006JE002735
sources.access: official public USGS/S3 product; bounded 128x128 ISIS tile HTTP range reads cached locally (opt-in download)
sources.checksums: window-scoped asset SHA-256 and byte count recorded in pipelines/pilots/d03_planetary_thermal/assets.json
sources.crs_frame: Equirectangular planetocentric simple cylindrical, R=3396190 m (+proj=eqc +lat_ts=0 +lat_0=0 +lon_0=0 +R=3396190); coordinate_frame mars_projected in typed areas
sources.resolution: 100 m/pixel native; 1.98 km circular window spatial mean; not resampled to 90 m
sources.time_support: apparent thermal inertia treated as time-independent by retrieval; per-pixel acquisition time/season/local solar time not carried by mosaic (static support)
sources.depth_support: upper few centimetres (apparent thermal inertia); no fixed depth interval
sources.qa: no explicit no-data constant in ISIS label; non-finite/non-positive/>10000 rejected and counted; no per-pixel QA layer
sources.uncertainty: published absolute accuracy ~20%, relative within one image ~10%; no per-pixel uncertainty layer; interval recorded per observation when detected
sources.legal_score_filter_roles: evidence_only only; excluded from cross-body similarity scoring

features.measured_modeled_derived_evidence_no_cov: derived_retrieval_evidence (detected values present); not an in-situ measurement and not a surface temperature
features.time_support: static/time-independent retrieval semantics; no per-pixel acquisition time, season, or local solar time available
features.season_support: unsupported_by_product (retrieval treats apparent TI as time-independent; seasonal effects not separable per pixel)
features.day_night_support: unsupported_by_product (no day/night acquisition split in this mosaic)
features.footprint: circular 1.98 km window of native 100 m pixels; bounded tile reads only; bbox recorded in Mars projected frame
features.uncertainty: published ~20% absolute / ~10% relative accuracy; represented as published_range interval; no per-pixel uncertainty
features.gaps: no time series possible from mosaic (and must not be invented); no per-pixel time/season/LST; retrieval does not correct clouds/slopes/subsurface ice-bedrock; coverage only 5 Jezero windows in tile 00N060E

cross_body_comparability.reason: Brightness temperature, thermal inertia, and Earth air/skin temperature are different physical quantities with different methods, supports, time semantics, and emissivity/model assumptions. No approved D03 similarity feature or shared method exists.
cross_body_comparability.enforcement: All committed D03 observations carry score_role evidence_only or context_only; no cross-body D03 score is produced.

rebuild_instructions: uv run python scripts/build_planetary_thermal_pilot.py --download  # opt-in; caches raw PCP tables and THEMIS tile blocks under var/cache/thermal-43/
uv run python scripts/build_planetary_thermal_pilot.py              # offline rebuild from cache into pipelines/pilots/d03_planetary_thermal/

Earth D03 POWER pilot is committed under pipelines/pilots/d03_earth_power/; rebuild via acquisition pipeline with nasa-power provider for D03 Earth pilot areas if re-acquisition is needed (network, opt-in).
python3 scripts/d03_thermal_query_evidence.py  # time-selector/LST query evidence over committed pilot exports
gaps_and_blockers: Moon: only 00:00-00:15 and 12:00-12:15 LST bins committed for 18 windows; adding more of the 96 official PCP bins requires opt-in download/cache of additional ~200 MB tables per bin and bounded processing.
Moon: 7 noon-bin windows have no native coverage and 3 have sparse coverage (<5 bins) - recorded as no_coverage/unknown, not zero-filled.
Mars: THEMIS quantitative TI mosaic carries no per-pixel acquisition time/season/LST; time-series expansion is not possible from this product and must not be invented.
Earth: POWER is coarse modeled/reanalysis context (not measured 1.98 km temperature); committed window is one 7-day period only.
Shared API time-selector query endpoints/schemas are out of scope for D03 ownership (#141 if changes needed); query evidence is provided via committed data and scripts.
No global/exhaustive D03 coverage claimed for any body.
